about.metaDescription: About Maqalat — who we are, why we write, and our editorial principles: primary official sources, honesty about limits, and no fabricated claims.
about.intro: Maqalat is a bilingual reference platform for topics that matter — calendar and events, universities, health, finance, cars, and more. Every article is written to be read, not skimmed.
about.missionBody: Readers deserve a reference that respects their intelligence and cites its work. We publish primary-sourced information — not recycled summaries — and we make it accessible in both Arabic and English.
about.whyItem1: Official sources cited for every number, medical claim, and legal reference.
about.whyItem2: Written by humans — no machine translation, no filler.
about.whyItem3: Kept current where it matters: dates, fees, regulations, exchange rates.
about.whyItem4: Transparent limits — when we don't know something, we say so.
about.whoBody: Maqalat's content is run by the editorial team — no fabricated individual byline, no anonymous 'staff' signature. The rule is fixed: nothing is published without a verifiable primary source. See our verification methodology for the step-by-step process.
about.contactBody: Have a suggestion, note, or correction? Visit the <link>contact page</link>. Corrections especially welcome.
about.policyBody: See the <link>editorial policy</link> for how we choose topics, verify sources, and handle mistakes.

contact.metaDescription: How to reach the Maqalat team — send feedback, a correction, a content suggestion, or a collaboration inquiry. We reply within 48 business hours.
contact.subtitle: Suggestions, notes, and corrections are all welcome.
contact.commentsCardBody: Comment directly under any article. We read every comment and answer serious questions.
contact.errorBody: Accuracy is non-negotiable. If you find wrong information, an outdated figure, or a broken source, email us with the article link and the location of the error. We fix it and credit you at the end of the article.

author.standardsIntro: How the Maqalat team operates — published openly so readers can hold us accountable:
author.standardSourcesBody: Every procedural, legal, financial, or medical number is linked to its official source inline in the text, not only in a footer list.
author.standardYmylBody: Medical, financial, and legal articles carry a safety notice and direct readers to a licensed professional. We never present content as a substitute for a doctor.
author.standardHonestyBody: When we cannot find an updated official source, we say so openly: 'no source found — consult the authority,' instead of guessing.
author.standardCorrectionsBody: Any error is corrected within 48 business hours with a visible update date. Report an error via the email above.
